row.evidence: Baserow's SSO docs say it "currently supports JIT (Just-In-Time) provisioning" and "Full SCIM (User syncing/deprovisioning) is not currently supported via the Admin Panel."
row.notes: Unchanged from June: no SCIM at any tier (now stated explicitly in Baserow's docs). Prices unchanged: Free, Premium $10/u/mo and Advanced $18/u/mo billed yearly ($12 and $22 monthly), Enterprise on request (self-hosted only). SAML/OIDC SSO with JIT is on Advanced and Enterprise, but the cloud pricing table marks SSO as unavailable on every cloud tier and the setup guides require a self-hosted Instance Admin, so SSO is effectively self-hosted Advanced+. Okta, Entra and OneLogin work via custom SAML apps (no catalogue listing found). Self-hosted instances have an instance-admin user API (list/create/update/deactivate/delete users) on all self-hosted installs; workspace member, invitation, team and role endpoints exist on all plans. Audit-log API is Advanced+ (workspace-level on cloud).

plans.name: Advanced
plans.price_text: $18 per user/month billed yearly ($22 billed monthly)
plans.notes: SSO only on self-hosted Advanced; the cloud pricing table shows SSO unavailable on all cloud tiers.

limitations.text: Only JIT provisioning on SSO sign-in; no SCIM user sync or automated deprovisioning.

auth.notes: Admin, workspace, team and role endpoints use a user JWT (OpenAPI security 'JWT'); database tokens only cover table/row operations.

capabilities.notes: Instance-wide user create/update/deactivate/delete (admin/users) is for staff on self-hosted instances; on cloud, admins manage workspace members via invitations, workspace-user update/delete, teams and role assignment.

endpoints.purpose: Update user attributes incl. active/admin status (staff)
Invite an email address to a workspace
Assign or remove a role for a subject in a workspace scope

webhooks_user_events.notes: Webhooks are per table and fire on row/field/view events; no user or member events documented.

rate_limits.text: Self-hosted: no rate limits. Cloud: 10 concurrent requests.

limitations.text: Instance-wide user management (admin/users) is only for Instance Admins (staff) on self-hosted plans.

okta.notes: Baserow documents a custom SAML 2.0 app created in Okta (no OIN app; okta.com/integrations/baserow/ returns 404). JIT only.

entra.notes: Baserow has a dedicated SAML guide for Azure AD (Entra ID); no Entra gallery tutorial found (baserow-tutorial 404).

google.notes: Google is supported as an OAuth 2.0 (social login) provider, not SAML.

onelogin.notes: Baserow documents a OneLogin SAML guide; OneLogin catalogue not checked (bot-blocked).
